metadata.title: Training images for multiple-point geostatistics as CSV
metadata.description:
Six categorical training images from the library of Mariethoz & Caers (2014), Multiple-point Geostatistics: Stochastic Modeling with Training Images, converted from GSLIB to CSV with cell-centre coordinates, a README per image (facies codes, proportions, suggested exercises) and a preview. Compiled for teaching; the images belong to their original authors.

  • strebelle: the 250 × 250 sand/shale channel image (Strebelle, 2002).
  • bangladesh: a 768 × 243 braided-river channel network.
  • ohau: the braided Ohau River, New Zealand, 176 × 440.
  • lena-delta: channels, land and lakes of the Lena River delta, 598 × 600.
  • dunes: a 114 × 114 three-facies dune field.
  • west-coast-africa: three 78 × 59 × 116 images of stacked deepwater channels.

Source library: https://github.com/GAIA-UNIL/trainingimages, GPL-3.0; this copy is shared under the same license.
